summary: Healey's Israel-Palestine record is defined by personal and institutional alignments with Israel. In October 2023 she posted on X that Massachusetts' bond with Israel is built from family bonds. As state attorney general she accepted a free 2016 trip to Israel paid by the America-Israel Friendship League. In 2024 she signed budget provisions for antisemitism curricula tied to the US National Strategy, which critics warned could restrict criticism of Israel, though no explicit IHRA mandate is established.
